name: The Carousel of Sleeping Giants
description: An ancient carousel built into a mountainside where each horse is carved from different precious stones, and the riders are sleeping giants whose dreams create the colors of dawn.
prompt: An enormous ancient carousel built into the side of a mountain, ornate horses carved from various precious stones - jade, amethyst, rose quartz, and lapis lazuli, each horse ridden by a sleeping giant whose peaceful dreams manifest as swirling colors of dawn in the sky above, golden morning light illuminating the scene, mystical mountain atmosphere, highly detailed fantasy art, epic scale
caption: Dreams big enough to paint the morning sky... 🐴🌄 What color would your slumber bring?
